title: User Playlists Contract And Web Slice
problem: The web playlist UI cannot return until Nako has a server-owned current-user playlist contract distinct from catalog collections and HLS transport playlists.
evidence: UPCW-010 opened the lane from WDRP-050 and recorded that playlists should proceed as a backend/Public Client contract lane before web UI restoration.

UPCW-020 froze current-user private User Playlist route inventory, DTOs, access filtering, duplicate/order semantics, mutation request shape, OpenAPI schemas, generated TypeScript/Kotlin SDK expectations, and HTTP API notes.

UPCW-030 implemented principal-scoped User Playlist persistence, ordered idempotent membership, version-guarded mutations, and app-service validation without adding Public Client HTTP routes or web UI.
UPCW-040 exposed current-user User Playlist Public Client HTTP routes, access-filtered item responses/counts, Rust client convenience methods, and SDK inventory validation without restoring web UI.

UPCW-050 restored the first web playlist UI through Public Client live data, fixture fallback, route-owned playlist/view state, data-source/route/state tests, bundle budget validation, and desktop/mobile browser smoke.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with UPCW-060. Close the lane and split follow-ons for sharing, smart playlists, recommendation-generated lists, and offline sync.
